properties.name: Internal mobile ZIP selection envelope
properties.purpose: Selection only; service coverage uses complete selected ZCTAs and extends beyond this envelope.
properties.method: Take the convex hull of every vertex of the five official municipal boundaries and ZCTA 60035. Select a ZCTA if its intersection with this hull exceeds one square metre in EPSG:3857. Cover and shade the full original geometry of every selected ZCTA, including portions beyond the selection hull. No city-centre, centroid, prefix, or anchor-override selection.
